'''Quoc Phan''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 22nd at [[2001 Ontario Provincial Championship]] on 12 May 2001, according to Drew Liu's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2322">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-18-ontario-provs-tds-report-05-12-01d2322/ ontario-provs-tds-report-05-12-01], DeckTech (Drew "JediDrew" Liu, 18 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-18-ontario-provs-tds-report-05-12-01d2322/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
